description.value: Sushiwood is a Korean and Japanese fusion restaurant in Fernie, BC, part of a small multi-location chain also operating in Nelson and Castlegar. The menu blends two distinct culinary traditions under one roof.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Sushiwood Fernie is a Korean & Japanese fusion restaurant at 1221 7th Ave, Fernie, BC V0B 1M0, with phone (778) 519-5255. The site includes an 'ORDER NOW' button suggesting takeout is available. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no osm_id, address, or phone tags — all contact details sourced entirely from website. Address in OSM URL record includes a unit prefix 'A-' not consistently reflected on website (site shows '1221 7th Ave' without unit in some places and 'A-1221 7th Ave' in others).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open restaurant with confirmed address and operating website; a useful food stop for touring cyclists in Fernie.
